title: Company settings writable by a view-only user

message: dateOfIncorporation must be a valid ISO 8601 date string
addresses must contain no more than 2 elements
addresses must contain at least 2 elements
dailyCashLimit must be a number conforming to the specified constraints
yearlyCashPaymentLimit must be a number conforming to the specified constraints
yearlyCashReceiptLimit must be a number conforming to the specified constraints

note: All four PUTs passed the rights check (400 = only validation stopped the empty body). With a valid body Eve could change company name, addresses, cash limits and system settings.
